items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: I had the privilege of playing in the high school band for the benefit of John Philip Sousa.

ctx.x: I had the privilege of playing in the high school band for the benefit of John Philip Sousa. They had a parade of high school bands in Tulsa, Oklahoma. I didn't win any awards, but I played for him. That's a lot that quite a few people can't say.
